title: Supporting Very Large Models using Automatic Dataflow Graph Partitioning
selection_reason: Tofu partitions large DNN operator graphs across GPUs, lowers per-GPU memory footprint, and reports 25%–400% training speedups. This concrete large-model graph-partitioning and memory technique is transferable to model-parallel systems.
